propositions: The outbound mapper receives its assignee resolver via attribute injection rather than explicit parameter, causing silent degradation to non-authoritative results when injection fails
Attribute injection hides type errors: PR #120's Data Center adapter copied getattr without setting the attribute, making authoritative assignment resolution dead code
The injected _assignee_resolver attribute lacks type checking and requires type: ignore comments at wiring sites
Thread the resolver as an explicit keyword parameter through OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee, diff_canonical_fields, and compute_update_fields to eliminate attribute discovery
DC's constructor-bound resolver must be preserved as a fallback while allowing core-supplied resolvers to take precedence (current overwrite semantics)
